race.description: Georgina Holt 2026 Trainer Of The Year Hcp (55)
race.comment: MAYOR OF KINGSTON (3) is the one to beat after a well-backed BM50 win at Cloncurry, where he was wide throughout yet still put the race away by a length and a half. The rise to BM55 asks a little more, but weight relief and a recent Ewan line through VOUCHERS give him the strongest current profile. VOUCHERS (1) comes off a Cairns win over 1450m and has a solid record at this venue, though top weight and a mixed 1609m record keep the margin between the main pair honest. MORDECAI (5) was a sharp improver when second at Bowen and is proven at this track and distance, making him a genuine threat if he repeats that effort in stronger company. OVERLAND (4) arrives in winning form from Mdn grade at this venue, has Ryan Wiggins back aboard and brings the consistency to stay in the argument despite the awkward draw.
